cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(test_libedataserverui4 LANGUAGES C)

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)

# libedataserverui4-1.0.pc is generated by the recipe (PkgConfigDeps) and
# carries `Requires:` for gtk4/glib/... so a single lookup provides both the
# library and the headers of its public API.
pkg_check_modules(EDS_UI REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libedataserverui4-1.0)

# The generated module must describe the package we actually built.
if(NOT EDS_UI_VERSION STREQUAL "3.60.2")
	message(FATAL_ERROR
		"libedataserverui4-1.0.pc reports version '${EDS_UI_VERSION}', expected 3.60.2")
endif()

add_executable(test_libedataserverui4 src/test_libedataserverui4.c)
target_link_libraries(test_libedataserverui4 PRIVATE PkgConfig::EDS_UI)
